head: flat trim head, cross recess (#8 head per GM description)
notes: GM catalog description (gmpartsgiant) gives '#8- #10-32 X.250'; read as 10-32 x 1/4 with #8 head size, but the '#8-' prefix is ambiguous. Vendors list it as telescopic steering column lock ring/lever screw (pair), 1965-89 Corvette; CorvetteForum calls them 'two very small phillips screws'.
